site.sitedescription:
Lake Mbalang is located 15 km east of the town of Ngaundéré in Central Cameroon.
The lake lies today in the wooded Sudanian savannah zone, characterized by the presence of two main trees: Daniella oliveri (Caesalpiniaceae) and Lophira lanceolata (Ochnaceae).
